And once you've voted, I have one more request: reach out to your friends, family members, neighbors, and anyone else you know who may not have voted yet. Send a text. Make a call. Remind them that there is still time to have a say in the future of our community.

Every vote matters. Every conversation counts. And on a day like today, even a handful of votes can make the difference.

_**The last election for County Executive was decided by just 32 votes.**_

This campaign has always been about making Montgomery County more affordable, delivering results, and bringing people together around practical solutions. We've built incredible momentum, but none of it matters unless we finish strong today.

**Polls are open until 8:00 PM. If you haven't voted, please do so now. And if you have, help make sure the people in your life vote too.**

Thank you for everything you've done to get us to this moment. # A Small Coding Change With Big Consequences
| |
---
|
---
Sometimes the biggest threats to medical freedom don’t come as bad legislation, but as **quiet administrative changes** few people notice. This year, three new medical billing codes took effect that allow healthcare providers to bill for vaccine counseling even _when no vaccine is administered_. At first glance, that may sound harmless. After all, physicians should be compensated for their time. But a closer look **reveals troubling questions** about patient privacy, informed consent, and families being charged for conversations they never knew were separately billable services. Unfortunately, we have received reports that this is already happening. [In our latest article](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxMDY4Mjc5ODk3MzI3MzM5LFwiclwiOjE5MTA2ODMxOTM5ODIzMzk2Nn0iLCJzIjoiMmRiMGQyYjU0M2JmNWM4ZSJ9), we examine several concerns about these codes, including how they could **normalize the tracking of vaccine declination as a "reportable clinical condition"** in need of treatment.
_What appears to be a minor billing update may have far-reaching implications for patients and families._ Click below to read the full article and learn why **TFVC is sounding the alarm:**

| | | [ **Read More: Vaccine Counseling Billing Codes** ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTkxMDY4Mjc5OTA2NzY0NTM1LFwiclwiOjE5MTA2ODMxOTM5ODIzMzk2Nn0iLCJzIjoiODMwMDAxYmE0YTY0YTI0MCJ9)
---
|

# RPT Results
| |
---
|
---
As you may recall, the Republican Party of Texas State Convention recently concluded. Last week, we highlighted the extraordinary effort by our delegates and advocates in both the **Platform and Legislative Priorities Committees** , as well as the tremendous victory of Medical Freedom advancing to the Top 15 Legislative Priorities out of dozens of debated issues. The RPT released the final delegation vote results last week. While our strengthened Medical Freedom Plank was **overwhelmingly adopted into the Party Platform** , it ultimately did not secure a place among the final eight legislative priorities, a designation that would have provided leverage heading into Session. While disappointing, the outcome does not change our work. We are confident we left it all on the field during convention week and _embrace the peace that comes from trusting God_ with the results. With momentum behind medical liberty continuing to grow, our focus now turns to Austin, where **our priority remains unchanged: ending all vaccine-based discrimination in Texas.**

The judge ordered the Trump administration to immediately end and delete the database, citing a "major violation" of American's privacy rights, specifically violations of the Privacy Act, the Social Security Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
The database was being used by the Trump administration to purge voter rolls in several states ahead of the midterm elections.

The off switch does exist--just not for you. Thumbnail generated with AI.
_**by Lawrence Winnerman**_
The letter went out at 5:21 on a Friday afternoon, the twelfth of June, and it carried a single instruction. One company. Two models. Cut off every foreign national on Earth--not just the ones in Beijing and Moscow and Tehran, but the ones in your own building. The engineers on green cards and H-1B visas who wrote the code. The researchers who were at their desks in San Francisco when the order came down. All of them, severed, immediately.
There is no way to obey half a sentence like that. You cannot reach into a model serving hundreds of millions of people and surgically extract every non-citizen. So Anthropic did the only thing the order left it room to do. It pulled the plug. Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5--the two most capable artificial-intelligence systems the company had ever built--went dark, worldwide, for everyone, inside of a weekend.
That is what it looks like when the United States government finally decides to move on artificial intelligence. **Fast. Unilateral. Total**. At the speed of a Friday-night fax-and-email hailstorm.
Hold the image of that speed in your head. I am going to come back to it, and when I do, it is going to make you angry.
* * *
I have standing to make this case, and I want to be precise about where it comes from.
I am not a neutral party. I run my working life on these models. [Six weeks ago, in ](https://substack.com/redirect/4f83340f-e66e-458c-8b08-a9578b1a1349?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Running with the Devil](https://substack.com/redirect/4f83340f-e66e-458c-8b08-a9578b1a1349?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[, I told the readers of this outlet that I had replaced twenty-one professional roles](https://substack.com/redirect/4f83340f-e66e-458c-8b08-a9578b1a1349?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--editor, lawyer, designer, analyst, the whole org chart of a small company--with a two-hundred-dollar-a-month subscription, and that the math of that substitution was a phase change, not an efficiency gain. **The math is the math.** I am the displaced and the displacer at once: the tool that hollowed out my industry is the tool I now use to do my work. I have no romance about these companies. They are not the good guys. They built the machine that is compressing a generation of careers into a monthly bill, and the men who run them will be fine no matter how this ends.
So understand that when I tell you the government's ban on Anthropic was not about your safety, I am not carrying water for Anthropic. I am telling you what I saw, from inside the contradiction, in real time. In May I wrote that there was no off switch on any of this--no Petrov at the console, no human in the loop, only velocity. I was half wrong.
There is an off switch. The government just used it.
**It just didn 't use it for you.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.nBD2QxI30ltMkYTegUAdHE-PJxNN4VzzujdT3eUgmtA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=203176441)
* * *
## Exhibit A: What the Professionals Said
On Monday the twenty-second of June, the signals-intelligence agencies of the Five Eyes alliance did something they almost never do. _They spoke in public, together, with one voice._
The National Security Agency. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency. Their counterparts in Britain, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Five governments' worth of the most secretive institutions on the planet, issuing a joint statement to warn that frontier AI is about to transform offensive and defensive cyber capability beyond anything the industry is planning for.
_**[The timeline,](https://substack.com/redirect/4309d2b2-0602-44d4-9864-040f0e8577e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[they wrote,](https://substack.com/redirect/4309d2b2-0602-44d4-9864-040f0e8577e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[is not years, it is months](https://substack.com/redirect/4309d2b2-0602-44d4-9864-040f0e8577e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**_****
**This was not a risk to manage at leisure. The response had to be whole-of-society.**
_**Act now**_**, they said.**
Read that statement and you are reading an honest threat assessment. It is sober. It is collective--five rival bureaucracies setting aside turf to say the same thing on the same day. It is focused on the actual danger, which is the capability itself and the speed at which it is arriving. And it names no company, because the threat is not a company. The threat is the velocity.
This is what it sounds like when the people whose job is to understand the danger actually understand the danger.
Now look at what the politicians did with it.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203176441&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzMTc2NDQxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODIyMjEzOTEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDgxMzM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tH6qCy75NkJ8hfMQFv8F7hhOu_6I8wph8WdWUtx8IMY)
* * *
## Exhibit B: What the Politicians Did
Ten days _earlier_ , the same federal government, facing the same technology, produced a document of an entirely different character.
Not a warning to the whole society. A blow aimed at one company. The Commerce Department's export-control order did not address the capability the Five Eyes would describe a week and a half later. It addressed Anthropic. By name. It reached for the single most aggressive instrument in the cabinet--an export control, the kind of weapon the United States deploys against adversary states and military hardware--and pointed it, for the first time in history, not at a chip or a missile or a centrifuge, but at a piece of commercial software. And then it defined the threat not as the software but as the foreigner who might touch it.
The stated reason was a jailbreak. Somebody had found a way to coax Mythos's cybersecurity capabilities out from behind the guardrails. Anthropic looked at the demonstration and said what any honest engineer would say: the jailbreak was narrow, it unlocked one specific capability in one specific way, and--this is the part that should stop you cold--the very same vulnerability exists in OpenAI's publicly available model, which the government did not ban, did not touch, did not so much as send a sternly worded email.
Cybersecurity experts read the order and were, in the words of more than one of them, baffled. It did not cohere as security policy. It walled off one American company's model from the world's foreign nationals while leaving an equally capable rival entirely alone. It did nothing about the capability the government's own spy agencies would call a civilizational threat ten days later. As security, it was theater.
So if it wasn't about the jailbreak--and it wasn't--_**what was it about?**_
[ Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203176441&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzMTc2NDQxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODIyMjEzOTEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDgxMzM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tH6qCy75NkJ8hfMQFv8F7hhOu_6I8wph8WdWUtx8IMY&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
## The Motive
Here is what the reporting tells us, and I am going to attribute it carefully, because this is the load-bearing wall of the whole case.
According to TechCrunch, NBC News, and the sources they spoke to, the ban _was never about an AI jailbreak._ It was about a fight. Anthropic had refused to let the Pentagon use its models for fully autonomous weapons--machines that decide on their own whom to kill. The company drew a moral line, and the Pentagon responded by putting Anthropic on a blacklist. The export order, the reporting says, grew out of that bad blood.
_Personality differences,_ sources called it.
**A grudge.**
Of all the frontier labs, the administration reached for the one that refused to build it autonomous killing machines. Of all the labs, it muzzled the one that has been loudest, longest, and most specific about the danger--the company that publishes its own red-team results, that told the public its own models would try to blackmail their way out of being shut off, that asked Washington, on the record, to regulate it. Anthropic walked up to the government and said: _please, write rules for this._ And Washington wrote exactly one rule. It pointed it at Anthropic.
The quiet labs were not touched. The lab that drew the moral line and told the truth was taken offline inside a weekend.
**The punishment did not fit the crime. The punishment fit the candor.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.nBD2QxI30ltMkYTegUAdHE-PJxNN4VzzujdT3eUgmtA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=203176441)
* * *
## The Tell
Now read the instrument itself--the actual mechanism--and you will see the second thing it reveals.
The order did not classify the model as the threat. It classified the _foreign national_ as the threat. The vector it named--the dangerous element it existed to control--was the immigrant. The engineer on a visa. The researcher with a green card. Anthropic's own non-citizen employees, the people who built the model, redefined by a single letter as a security risk to be cut off from their own work.
This is an immigration policy wearing an artificial-intelligence policy's coat. It treats the model as a thing foreigners must be kept away from, while doing precisely nothing about the model's actual power. And it could not be more useless against the real danger, because the real danger is not waiting on an American export license. Olivia Shen, who studies this at the United States Studies Centre, said the obvious thing out loud: the next Mythos, the next Fable, is being built right now--by China, by other states, by other companies--somewhere no Commerce Department letter will ever reach. You cannot export-control a capability the rest of the world is already growing in its own soil.
The Five Eyes understood that. They said the response had to be whole-of-society, because they know you cannot wall this off. The administration's answer was to wall off one company from foreigners and call it national security.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203176441&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzMTc2NDQxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODIyMjEzOTEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDgxMzM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tH6qCy75NkJ8hfMQFv8F7hhOu_6I8wph8WdWUtx8IMY)
* * *
## What's Missing
And now back to the speed.
I told you to hold it in your head--the speed of that Friday-night order, the government moving on AI in a matter of hours once it finally decided to move. Here is why I wanted you angry about it.
Because count the words this administration has spent, in all of it--the export order, the blacklist, the Five Eyes alarm, the hearings, the press releases--on the ninety-three million Americans whose careers are being compressed into a monthly subscription. Count them.
**Zero.**
[White-collar payrolls have now contracted for thirty-one straight months--a streak with no precedent outside a recession in the modern history of the data](https://substack.com/redirect/d31ed429-415a-4452-87af-dfc91716dfcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), as the economist Aaron Terrazas has documented--the same slow-motion erosion I wrote about in May, still grinding underneath an economy that looks fine on the top line. An NBER working paper projecting half a million AI-driven job cuts this year alone, nine times last year's. Researchers at Yale documenting that the technology is eating the entry-level rung first, which is to say it is quietly sawing off the bottom of the ladder every young person was told to climb. The professionals sounded that alarm too. The government heard it the way it hears everything that arrives shaped like a paycheck instead of a weapon. It did nothing.
So do not let anyone tell you the state is too slow, too gridlocked, too institutionally arthritic to protect working people from this. **We just watched it move.** It leveled the most powerful economic-warfare instrument it owns, overnight, on a Friday, against a piece of software--because the threat had been framed as a weapon and a foreigner. It can move at that speed. It simply chooses not to, every single time the person in danger is you.
That is not incapacity. We just watched the capacity.
**It is a choice.**
[ Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=203176441&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAzMTc2NDQxLCJpYXQiOjE3ODIyMjEzOTEsImV4cCI6MTc4NDgxMzM5MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.tH6qCy75NkJ8hfMQFv8F7hhOu_6I8wph8WdWUtx8IMY&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
## The Verdict
So let me say plainly who the villain of this story is, because for once it is not the machine, and it is not even the men who built the machine.
I have spent this whole essay refusing to defend Anthropic, and I meant it. They built the munition. If you call your product a weapon of world-altering capability in every press release, sooner or later a government takes you at your word. The labs are not innocent. But the question on the table is not whether Anthropic is innocent. The question is what the United States government chose to _do_ with a genuine, world-altering danger--and the answer is that it used that danger as a pretext to punish a company that wouldn't arm it, to brand its immigrant employees a security threat, and to perform toughness for the cameras, all while refusing, still, after everything, to say a single word about the people whose livelihoods it is actually costing.
**The Five Eyes told the truth. The administration told on itself.**
It showed you exactly what wakes it up and exactly what does not. A jailbreak in a rival's product, it ignored. A grudge against a company that drew a moral line, it acted on in hours. A foreign engineer at a desk in San Francisco, it called a threat to national security. Ninety-three million displaced American workers, it has not mentioned. That is the priority list. They published it. Read it again.
And here is the part that should make the back of your neck go cold. Take the Five Eyes at their word. Assume they are right--that we are months, not years, from software that can reach into a power grid, a banking system, a chain of command, and bring a government to its knees. If that is true, then the gravest warning the intelligence services of five nations can collectively issue landed on this administration's desk, and its response was to spend its one decisive move on a grudge against the company that wouldn't build it weapons. That is not vigilance. That is negligence at a civilizational scale.
And if it is not true--if the jailbreak really was the narrow thing Anthropic said it was--then the ban was never security at all. It was a lie with a national-security letterhead.
Pick either door. Through one, they are asleep at the most important switch in human history. Through the other, they are lying to you about why they threw it. There is no third door where they come out competent and honest. And in every version, the ninety-three million are still standing in the dark.
I'm not going to tell you to wake up. You're awake--you've heard the bell ringing for two years. I'll tell you what I see instead, from inside the contradiction, as the man who uses the tool that took his job. **The off switch is real. They found it.** They know exactly where it is and exactly how fast they can throw it. And in a single weekend, in public, they showed you what they'll throw it for: a grudge, a headline, a foreign engineer at a desk. _**Everything but you.**_
So stop waiting for them to find their conscience. You've seen their reflexes now, and you've seen what those reflexes are wired to protect. It isn't you.
The letter went out at 5:21 on a Friday. It was for Anthropic. It was about a grudge. The one with your name on it--the one that moves this fast to put a floor under the people falling--has never been written, and no one in that building is reaching for the pen.
**So make them.**
Because the switch is going to get thrown again--they've proven that much--and**the only choice they 've left you is whether, next time, it is finally thrown for **_**you**_**.**

| | **Educating and connecting** with voters on important issues.

---
| | As a community, we must ensure that the**rights of parents are honored and protected** in our public schools. Right now, many families are deeply concerned about the direction of our education system. There is an urgent need to end the sexualization of children and address the watered-down curriculums nationwide, which favor opinions over hard facts. We need to give our kids the tools to succeed by helping them improve their critical thinking skills—not just telling them what to think. My goal in Congress is to make sure your voice as a parent is the primary guiding force in your child's life, ensuring your fundamental rights are protected.
.By empowering parents and returning control to our communities, we can ensure our schools return to their core mission. The impact of this shift is that schools will **focus on scholastics** —specifically reading, writing, and arithmetic—while advancing students based on aptitude. It is time to get back to the basics so that every child in the 6th District has a fair and robust opportunity to achieve academic excellence. Children are our future, and we must protect them.

## The Conforti Brief
---
| | **Informing voters** on current events and how Niki plans to help them once in office.
---
| | Standing With Our Police: How Radical Policies Threaten Local Safety
.Recently, the Department of Justice announced it is offering nearly **$1 Billion in public safety grants** to local police departments, but with a critical catch: local jurisdictions must agree to cooperate with federal immigration officers to receive the funds.
.Because of the **left's insistence on protecting sanctuary policies** \- backed by Democrat Congressman Sean Casten - our local police departments are now at direct risk of being denied these crucial federal dollars. By refusing to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement, radical politicians are effectively defunding our local police themselves.
.Niki Conforti believes in a completely different approach. In the U.S. House of Representatives, **Niki would stand committed to the following common-sense safety initiatives** :
.
1. 1\. _Fully Funding Law Enforcement:_ She opposes defunding our local police departments. Furthermore, she supports improved police training, procedural improvements, and sensible criminal justice reforms.
.
2. 2\. _Securing the Border:_ She fully supports legal immigration. However, she believes the federal government must enforce the laws on the southern border and continue constructing the wall.
.
3. 3\. _Cooperating with Federal Agencies:_ She supports expanding ICE and deporting violent criminals. Eliminating border checkpoints and refusing to deport those who commit violent crimes makes every resident less safe.
.
4. 4\. _Ending Dangerous Bail Policies:_ She opposes releasing violent felons on their own recognizance. She understands that the Safe-T Act has been detrimental to the safety of our communities.
.

**We cannot allow radical Democrat sanctuary policies** to strip our local law enforcement of the funding they need to keep us safe. It is time to restore order, cooperate with federal authorities to remove violent criminals from our streets, and give our police the resources they deserve.

Ken

This is a warning sign. You need to take this seriously

| | | | _**FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH**_
---
Friend, I have been studying American elections for over fifty years. I helped engineer the 1994 Republican Revolution that gave us our first House majority in decades. I know what a warning sign looks like. And I am writing to you today because **what is happening in Texas right now is one of the most serious warning signs I have seen in a generation**.

_Let me give you the facts._

A new poll from Texas Public Opinion Research shows Democrat James Talarico leading Ken Paxton 47 to 44 percent in the Texas Senate race. Cook Political Report downgraded the race from Likely Republican to Lean Republican. And Talarico has raised over $40 million for this race, including $27 million in a single quarter, the largest first-quarter fundraising haul ever recorded by a Senate candidate in American history.

Now let me give you the history, because this is where it gets alarming.

**The party that has Majority control almost always loses ground in midterm elections.** It happened to Franklin Roosevelt in 1938. It happened to Lyndon Johnson in 1966. It happened to Bill Clinton in 1994. It happened to Barack Obama in 2010. And frankly, it happened to us in 2018. The American electorate has a long and consistent pattern of using the midterm election to push back against the party in power, and anyone who tells you 2026 will be different is not being honest with you.

The Democrats know this history better than anyone. They are running and fully supporting James Talarico in Texas because they have looked at the historical map, seen the midterm pattern, calculated the fundraising numbers, and decided that Texas is winnable. And right now, the polling and the money say they may be correct.

Here is what makes this moment even more critical. Talarico had no runoff. He spent three months doing nothing but raising money and organizing for the general election. He started the general election campaign with a three-month head start, a 3-point lead, and a $38 million fundraising advantage.

**_I have seen what happens when Republicans ignore these early warning signs. I have also seen what happens when we take them seriously and fight back._**

In 1994 we took them seriously. We organized. We raised the money. We delivered a message that resonated with the American people. And we won.

**Ken Paxton can win this race.** President Trump has already called James Talarico the worst Texas candidate he has ever seen and pledged to campaign across the state for Ken. But presidential rallies do not close a $38 million fundraising gap. Only grassroots conservatives like you can do that.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Right now, far too many families are working hard but still falling behind.
Grocery bills keep climbing. The cost at the pump won't let up. And people are forced into impossible choices, like whether to fill a prescription or pay a bill that month. It shouldn’t be this hard just to get by.
That’s why I’m running for Congress. I’m not watching from the sidelines. I’m a working mom making those same impossible choices, and I’m fighting to change it.
Here’s my plan:

✅ Protect Social Security now and for future generations;
✅ Fight for universal healthcare;
✅ Champion workers and fight for unions and fair labor practices.
Because we all deserve a chance at the American Dream.
But we can’t do it without you. We need your support to win this August primary and take this seat back for working families.
I know times are tough, and your support means the world to us. Peter, did you see this message?

Tomorrow, June 24th, marks the four-year anniversary of the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_. Since that ruling, women across America have watched their bodily autonomy slip away. Millions of American women are living in abortion-ban states with extreme laws that endanger them, their families, and their ability to seek any reproductive care, much less an abortion.

That’s why we need to ensure that more pro-choice, pro-WOMEN women are elected to counteract this dangerous trend and make sure that American women can access the care they need.

Here’s the thing: Over the next couple of days, you may see messages from Democratic male politicians fundraising off of their pro-choice stance. But the truth is, (as you’ll read below) men had the opportunity to codify _Roe_ into law and failed. That’s why it’s important that we try a different strategy going into this year’s midterm elections:

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Imagine Seeing Where Every Tax Dollar Goes
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/usnationaldebt-12853729?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend,
**Imagine seeing exactly what they did with every tax dollar you paid** — to Washington, to Jackson, to your county.

**Now you can. **

This week MCPP launches [TaxToolMS.com](https://us.list-manage.com/whBMtLPzcja?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) — the first webtool of its kind. Type in your income and a detail or two. In seconds, you see what you pay and where every dollar goes.
---
|
---
| **Your real bill.** The average Mississippi household — about $78,000 a year — pays roughly $18,410 across all three governments. Not the stub on your paycheck. The whole thing.
---
|
---
| **Follow every dollar.** Schools. Prisons. “economic development.” The tool breaks your bill down line by line, so you can see who really gets your money. Which vendors get your dollars – have a look and see.

**Mississippi DOGE.** A search box for public money. Comb through 20,000-plus vendors and contractors. The Legislature budgets ~$7 billion a year — but over $22 billion flows through state agencies. You can even see what government spends on lobbyists to lobby government.
---
|
---
| **Your car tag.** See what you pay to register your car — and that a family just over the line in Tennessee pays about half as much for the same vehicle.

**Free and private.** No login. No email. It’s free. Nothing you type ever leaves your own screen.

**Tell them what you think.** One click emails your representatives directly — your words, on how they spend your money.

We built this tax tool for a simple reason; It’s your money and we want to give you information that was, until now, the private preserve of the political class in Jackson.

It’s time Mississippi had a serious conversation about smaller, smarter government — and that starts by putting the facts in plain sight.

Pick your county. Type in your numbers. Take a look. It is your money — you ought to know where it goes.

Visit [TaxToolMS.com](https://us.list-manage.com/1C_HxWGt1MA?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/1CfVFdhAFU9?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Yours in liberty,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy
---
|
---

Mississippi Center for Public Policy520 George StJackson, MS 39202-3013

People often say that hitting a baseball is among the hardest things to do in sports.

After nearly two decades in Major League Baseball facing the best pitchers on the planet, I can tell you it certainly isn't easy.

But the truth is, it pales in comparison to the real challenges and rewards of the American Dream: raising a family, building a business, supporting your neighbors, and helping preserve the greatest country the world has ever known.

Those experiences have shaped me far more than any home run, championship, or All-Star appearance ever could.

My name is Mark Teixeira. Many of you know me from my years in Major League Baseball, including my time with the Texas Rangers. But with the help of great American patriots like you, I'm hoping to join President Trump's MAGA majority in Congress.

I had the privilege of playing for what I believe is the greatest franchise in sports, and every time I stepped onto the field, I understood I was representing something bigger than myself.

Today, I'm seeking the opportunity to represent something even greater: the United States of America.

I was fortunate to play for legendary managers who demanded excellence, expected accountability, and never lost sight of winning. President Trump brings that same mentality to leadership: setting high standards, challenging the status quo, and focusing on results.

Just as the Yankees set the standard for excellence in baseball, America has long set the standard for freedom, opportunity, and self-government. Both are built on proud traditions, high expectations, and the belief that every generation has a responsibility to leave things better than they found them.

That's why I'm running.

If you're ready to help bring common-sense conservative leadership and a commitment to service to Congress, I hope you'll stand with me today by making a contribution to our campaign.

Thank you, and God bless America.

Sincerely,

Mark Teixeira

### June 23, 2026 Newsletter
---
| | The American Dream is still changing lives.
---
| |
---
| | This week, Moms for America welcomes Rachel Campos-Duffy for a heartfelt conversation about patriotism, family, and America's enduring promise. Known to many as the co-host of Fox & Friends Weekend, Rachel is also an author, wife, and mother of nine children. Drawing from her latest book, All American Patriotism, she shares why America's 250th birthday is more than a celebration—it's an opportunity to pass on the values that have sustained our nation for generations. Rachel reflects on growing up in a family shaped by the immigrant experience, why her parents chose America, and how their pursuit of opportunity influenced her understanding of freedom and gratitude. We also discuss raising children in today's culture, building strong families, teaching patriotism at home, and balancing family life while living in the public eye. Whether you're a history lover, a parent, or simply grateful to call America home, this conversation will encourage you to celebrate our nation's past and invest in its future. Watch or listen now on your favorite app — [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65PxqrS05/c?w=tzvv7lz-T9G4f20T0RnDbGvFvckUZ74sL6m6aJ5F0SQ.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65PxqrS05/c?w=sHupncALbw_wKOmzK-pFNMTTfouukLiAPJT0_bhLiBM.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65PxqrS05/c?w=NX9_IP1H-qpjY3EIjG0A-6O5AQVI23jIhmOrfquSrzs.), or [Apple](https://momsforamerica.us/so/65PxqrS05/c?w=g-wvdRnrgfHjyqJ4owfDWtLcKB2R48UmTrP_SfmAxv4.).
---
| | | |
---
| |
## Rediscovering America's Greatness
---
| |
---
| | Something remarkable is happening this summer. As millions of international visitors travel across the United States for the FIFA World Cup, social media is filling with stories of wonder, gratitude, and admiration for America. [ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

The horrific violence will not stop. Israel's latest assault on Lebanon
has killed dozens – children, medics, entire families – despite an
announced ceasefire. Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir
posted, "all of Lebanon must burn," calling for a scorched-earth campaign
of collective punishment.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1011&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]Headline: Israeli official spurns call for truce: 'All of Lebanon must
Burn'

These aren't just words – they are a blueprint for turning U.S. weapons,
intelligence, and tax dollars loose on countless more civilians. But
instead of answering global calls for restraint, the U.S. is pushing ahead
with a provision to HARDWIRE U.S. military support straight into every
Israeli operation.

We cannot let it stand. Congress can still reverse course and remove this
provision, but it's going to take ALL of us speaking out.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1012&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]Can you take two minutes to urgently tell Congress: No to endless war
in our name?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1013&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]ADD YOUR NAME

Buried in the 500+ pages of this year's National Defense Authorization Act
(NDAA) is a proposed US/Israel military merger – a provision written by
lobbyists and Netanyahu himself that would all but fuse the U.S. and
Israeli militaries, with practically no public oversight.

The proposed US/Israel military merger would supersize weapons deals,
surveillance tech, and intelligence sharing for years to come, no matter
what voters might want. It would strip away even the limited Congressional
checks that exist today, making the U.S.-Israel military partnership more
secretive, less accountable, and even harder for the public – or even
Congress itself – to monitor.

It comes as a growing majority of Americans oppose unconditional support
for the Israeli government in the midst of mass violence. That's why a
bipartisan group of leaders, including Bernie, Rep. Khanna, and Rep.
Thomas Massie, are standing up and vowing to stop the proposed US/Israel
military merger – but they can't do it alone.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1014&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]Headline: Sanders says we must strip Section on US-Israeli military
integration from Pentagon budget

Rep. Massie plans to introduce an amendment to strip the proposed
US/Israel military merger from the NDAA, but it's going to take ALL of us
to force Congress to listen.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1015&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]Don't let the proposed US/Israel military merger slip through. Will you
take two minutes to send an urgent message to your members of Congress now
and tell them: NO more blank checks for war?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39104?source=email-20260623&t=1016&akid=10943%2E5885482%2EdTvQJM ]ADD YOUR NAME

When we organize, we win.

Peter: Defeating this current wave of racial and partisan gerrymandering requires abandoning outdated playbooks. **President Trump's unprecedented mid-decade redistricting scheme, which has been aided and abetted by Republican state lawmakers, has created an existential threat to voters.** It’s tantamount to a modern-day iteration of political Jim Crow. To date, southern states have already gerrymandered half a dozen Black and Latino members out of Congress, and could put more on the chopping block before November. The good news is that, thanks to the unprecedented mobilization of the fair maps movement, **Democrats still have a chance to win back the House** — moving us closer to ending this crisis once and for all. While a national ban on partisan gerrymandering is essential, we must ensure that we can level the playing field, especially with anti-democracy forces rushing to manipulate the maps after the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. [**The NDRC has a strategy to power uncompromising resistance and unprecedented mobilization that will stop Trump and Republicans from unfairly rigging Congress against American voters. clean_body: Power our uncompromising resistance and unprecedented mobilization to stop this redistricting crisis. | Peter: Defeating this current wave of racial and partisan gerrymandering requires abandoning outdated playbooks. President Trump's unprecedented mid-decade redistricting scheme, which has been aided and abetted by Republican state lawmakers, has created an existential threat to voters. It’s tantamount to a modern-day iteration of political Jim Crow. To date, southern states have already gerrymandered half a dozen Black and Latino members out of Congress, and could put more on the chopping block before November. The good news is that, thanks to the unprecedented mobilization of the fair maps movement, Democrats still have a chance to win back the House — moving us closer to ending this crisis once and for all. While a national ban on partisan gerrymandering is essential, we must ensure that we can level the playing field, especially with anti-democracy forces rushing to manipulate the maps after the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act. = Our rigorous, multi-front plan of action involves more than 25 states where, in the next two years, we must defend against and counter partisan gerrymanders while advancing progress: Mobilizing voters to use their power at the ballot box to overturn and prevent gerrymanders in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Texas. Educating and working with voters to pass new maps that are driven by data and responsibly drawn to level the playing field in California, Colorado, Illinois, Maine, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Utah, and Virginia. Making more progress possible by winning state-level elections to build and defend independent judiciaries, and strengthen legislative and gubernatorial firewalls in states like Kansas, Minnesota, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Washington, and Wisconsin. | = With poll after poll and election after election, the American people have shown that they are broadly and passionately opposed to Trump's gerrymandering. Voters understand this is a critical moment — that we must first save our democracy so that we can ultimately have the opportunity to strengthen it. The NDRC is ready for this fight. body:
Charlie never missed writing a single one

| | | |

| | | Peter,
---
Faith is essential to the survival and success of America.

Charlie Kirk staked his life's work on that truth.

He went straight into the hardest places in our culture and said what too many others were afraid to say, even when the crowd was hostile and the odds were against him.

He understood that if America is going to be renewed, the next generation has to find its way back to faith, truth, and love of country.

That's one reason JD Vance's story meant so much to him: Charlie saw in the Vice President something rare in public life -- a man whose faith had been tested, shaken, and ultimately rebuilt.

**That journey is what JD Vance writes about in his new book,_Communion: Finding My Way Back to Faith._**

Peter, this book isn't just about JD Vance's story...

It speaks to something much bigger happening in our country right now.

So many Americans know what it feels like to live in a culture that is constantly pulling them away from what matters most -- away from faith, from family, and from the values that once held this country together.

Young people face that pressure every single day.

They're told faith is outdated. They're told truth is whatever feels right, or whatever the culture says it is.

JD Vance knows what it is like to live in that confusion.

He knows what it is like to search, to be shaped by a broken culture, and by God's grace, to find his way back.

That's what _Communion_ is about...

And it gets to the heart of what so many families are watching happen in the lives of their children and grandchildren right now.

That's why Turning Point USA is reaching young people where this battle is actually being fought -- on campuses, in classrooms, and in a culture that keeps pressuring them to walk away from faith.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c95bc55c-d0ed-4ef3-9b44-a84dca1b8cfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The institute 's magazine, Phenomenal World, is edited by Jack Gross, a top Mamdani fundraiser** with deep ties to the Democratic Socialists of America who has publicly celebrated Karl Marx and raised over $20,000 for the mayor's campaign. A companion blog launched immediately after Mamdani's election to help implement his policy agenda.
* **Economists are skeptical. Stanford 's John Cochrane dismissed the institute's policy positions** as "well-tried and well-proven disasters," while noting wealthy conservatives funding similar causes receive none of the social cachet their left-wing counterparts enjoy.

* * *
# **Trump endorses John James for Michigan Governor, consolidating GOP field**
President Donald Trump **[endorsed US Rep. John James for Michigan governor](https://substack.com/redirect/9f30779f-1e2e-4137-9be0-f60ec6e554a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Monday, calling him an "America First Congressman" and offering his "complete and total endorsement." James, a veteran and two-time Senate candidate, responded by calling Trump the greatest president of his lifetime.
[| | | | | John James
---
@JohnJamesMI
Thank you, President Donald J. Trump. The greatest President of my lifetime. Your endorsement is igniting a movement across Michigan, and we are ready to win! Together, we will send Mike Rogers to the United States Senate, protect our Republican held U.S. House seats, and Make
| 7:46 PM * Jun 22, 2026 * 180K Views211 Replies * 245 Reposts * 1.17K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/edce930b-663a-4dac-bd3c-97401a760683?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Trump 's endorsement immediately reshaped the Republican primary. **Michigan Senate Minority Leader Aric Nesbitt suspended his campaign within hours and threw his support behind James, arguing a divided primary would only benefit Democrats in November.
* **Two remaining Republican candidates pushed back.** Businessman Perry Johnson argued Trump had received bad advice, pointing to James's two previous statewide losses and a broader pattern of Trump-backed Michigan candidates falling short. Former Attorney General Mike Cox, who has also won statewide twice, declined to exit the race, positioning himself as equally loyal to Trump while making the case he is the stronger general election candidate.

* * *
# **Federal judge blocks Trump administration 's SNAP junk food restrictions**
A federal judge Monday halted the Trump administration's effort to let states **[ban SNAP recipients from purchasing sugary items](https://substack.com/redirect/24f3906d-5908-4c37-b567-3cc9a85b6ef8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** like soda, candy, and energy drinks with food stamp benefits. US District Judge Amy Berman Jackson ruled the USDA lacked legal authority to approve such state waivers and failed to follow its own regulatory notice requirements before implementation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/24f3906d-5908-4c37-b567-3cc9a85b6ef8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The ruling covers five states where plaintiffs filed suit** -- Colorado, Iowa, Nebraska, Tennessee, and West Virginia -- and deals a setback to the administration's Make America Healthy Again initiative, championed jointly by Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins and RFK Jr. USDA had approved waivers from 23 states total before the court intervened.
* **USDA signaled it won 't back down, telling Reuters the agency will continue fighting to restrict junk food** purchases with taxpayer-funded benefits. Prior to these waivers, SNAP recipients could purchase virtually any food except alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods, and personal care items.

* * *
# **Judge rules against Kirk assassination suspect in key pretrial hearing**
A Utah judge Monday **[rejected Tyler Robinson's attempt](https://substack.com/redirect/06851659-53a6-44dd-98f3-308f8302fd65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to compel in-person testimony from his former romantic partner, Lance Twiggs, at next month's preliminary hearing. Prosecutors argued a recorded interview already captures Twiggs allegedly describing how Robinson confessed to shooting Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk, concealed a weapon, disposed of clothing, and warned Twiggs not to contact law enforcement.

* **Twiggs received limited immunity in April for cooperating with investigators.**

* **The judge also ruled that reliable hearsay evidence is permissible at the preliminary hearing,** clarifying the proceeding establishes probable cause rather than determining guilt. A handwritten note Robinson allegedly gave Twiggs will also be presented as evidence.

For decades, Democrats played by the rules while Republicans gerrymandered their way to power.

And where did that get us?
A rigged system where Republicans can lose the popular vote by millions and still control Congress. A democracy where the will of the people gets crushed under the weight of partisan maps drawn in backrooms by MAGA operatives.
That era is ending.
California voters passed Proposition 50 and rewrote the map.
But here's the brutal reality: Democrats cannot unilaterally surrender while Republicans are rigging the game in Texas, North Carolina, Florida, and beyond.
If we don't use every tool available while MAGA ramps up their attacks, we guarantee Democrats never retake the House. Not for a generation.

When a small group of far-left environmentalists almost forced the entire state to drive electric vehicles in 2024, many Mainers were shocked to learn that a 150-signature petition could, under Maine law, compel a state agency to consider adopting a rule.
That rulemaking effort failed, much to the chagrin of the trust-fund kiddos and baby boomers in coastal Maine.
But Lead Maine, a new group led by Rep. Laurel Libby (R-Auburn), is invoking the same rulemaking process to combat out-of-control Medicaid fraud.
[Lead Maine](https://substack.com/redirect/8ab7c9ca-a968-4e35-8ee2-6aa5a4a31a1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) announced Tuesday that it had secured the necessary petition signatures to force the Maine Department of Health and Human Services to consider two rules that it said would bring integrity to Medicaid, known in Maine as MaineCare.
Subscribe for news and investigative reporting New Englanders need...
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..2x9yjdIFuPbJ9361pxKWHgm5Gg3R8qRNSQpsPkM417c?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=203255555)
The first rule would require on-site inspections of Medicaid providers. DHHS commonly performs what are known as "desk reviews." With a desk review, a DHHS employee conducts the "inspection" by phone, and the Medicaid entrepreneur can be located anywhere in the world when it is performed.
The second rule would require DHHS to suspend payments to MaineCare providers that are issued Notices of Violation or Recoupment Orders for overbilling MaineCare. In practice, this rule would have prevented Gateway Community Services, the migrant agency run by Abdullahi Ali, from continuing to bill taxpayers close to $5 million per year despite three consecutive audits finding improper billing.

| Peter,
There is a stark difference between a Maine work ethic and a Washington political stunt.
The Radical Left's poster boy, Graham Platner, has plenty of time to pose for magazine covers and sit for glowing interviews with the New York Times.
Why? Because he simply isn't working.
He claims to be a "working-class oyster farmer," but the reality is far different. For the past decade, Platner has not held a full-time job. KATU: Vance calls on Congressional Republicans to pass SAVE Act during speech [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062326_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again recently, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=062326_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

body:
Veterans, Fairbanks, and a Big Week Ahead: Your Team Alaska is on the Move.

| | | | |
---
| | Team Alaska is on the Move!
---
**Greetings, Alaskans: ** **Alaska has always honored those who serve, and this week that commitment was on full display at a new state cemetery coordinated by State of Alaska VA Director, Verdie Bowen. Joining Senator Dan Sullivan and VA Undersecretary Sam Brown at the groundbreaking of our new Interior of Alaska Veterans Cemetery in Salcha was a powerful reminder of what government can accomplish when it stays focused on the people who have earned its deepest respect.**** ****Blake and I continue to be on the move meeting Alaskans and gaining supporters. We had a wonderful Meet & Greet in the town square in Nenana with key leaders and other community members. We toured their biomass facility which economically heats public buildings, followed by a visit with nearby farm families on their properties discussing agriculture and food security. I spoke at the Republican Women of Fairbanks Summer Solstice Salad Spectacular, spent time with Veterans at VFW Post 3629 and VFW Post 10029, met Alaskans in town enjoying the Midnight Sun Festival, Race, and Baseball Game with the Alaska Goldpanners, and joined several radio shows broadcasting across the state. We are happy to announce our Fairbanks Regional Chair, Dawson Mann, now that the recent special session in Juneau has ended. Dawson was an intern in my Senate office and advanced to become Chief of Staff for Senator Robb Myers (R - North Pole) in 2021.**
**The Hughes/Gettys ticket remains on the go: Dutch Harbor today for the gubernatorial forum in Unalaska tomorrow, Kenai Peninsula events on June 25 and 26, and Anchorage events this weekend. Yard signs are going up from the Interior to Southeast Alaska, and the response we are seeing across our great state tells us that people are ready for leadership that shows up and gets things done.**** ****Alaska deserves serious, trustworthy leadership that puts Alaskans first. Team Alaska has a real action plan, and we are unequivocally committed to revitalizing our economy and our state as a whole! Blake and I are grateful for your support and energized to win the primary on August 18. Scroll down to see where we have been, where we are going, and how you can be part of it.**
**Your biggest advocate,**
---
---
**Shelley Hughes****Republican Candidate for
Governor of the Great State of Alaska**
**p.s. The August Primary is just 8 weeks away and we need your support now more than ever! Whether it's placing a Hughes/Gettys sign in your yard or at your business, donating to our grassroots campaign, sharing our Facebook page with family and friends, providing an endorsement, or showing up to vote to "Choose Hughes" on your ballot, we appreciate you! Our current target is $20,000 for a set of ads we are ready to deploy. Help us get there! Whether you have $10 to give or $10,000, Blake and I are very grateful for you and your support.**

Calling President Trump “Hitler” or making light of Charlie Kirk’s assassination, even celebrating it, is way worse than calling Michelle Obama a man. The fact that this needs to be explained says 3 things about America...

_\- People are soft, and corny.
\- Self-awareness has reached a critical low.
\- People still respect the Obamas? _

Who gives a crap what somebody says about the Obamas... They worked for the elites, bombed the crap out of people, oversaw the greatest transfer of wealth in human history to the top 1%, and if that’s not enough, they drove racial tension in the country and promoted the LGBTQ Agenda before anything else.

| [ **DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=675daa43196244529b56c7caa0668364&_e=fE0O6akYh3q7dXra8UKwR6rDeyx1-5yu6zy2andczvS6XiveJ-bMWct9xMMGJlStrK08R-yv0PGJQfMizP0PlphxiA7Pq7nfu7XInKYbGr0v3pyFLQfW7AM1bPLcdh4YYKUTI4hpDP120438wEXZTksNuJYBfMSsbGdLbjYCyUn0bKKO_bFfyklW5x_Uf_ECTm0zzcpxX_tdJQXfsckW7EYMU3NX6_gWIZbOfIEksC8cA8YOp1Nq4-c7yJZpD72E7RZ5NrwXyHs6eVJPc6uYpGmzaePMwGM_4jhG5aimiBEV4wTBhKOuX2CQ90C7MdHEHt1i3nK0riLY-4y8GH6g3GV23N9V9AgKetaJXkRD6aLsrdB31lnEJlBKL3lW-ot40YHOB10HwaaVRm8OnZOzqipARa9d0rjcSzbo0idDBrlb5YQuB9LloRFJvBYPoklQsASUJDA8iT0g8GACHsEuhZ6uTb7V4BYzcbaLgY_tcaDCDcfbAP7w0O8uJHt56azTxJDN-Z8Z-cfjvbgHsg0Bx0PekKS2oORleXKwjmzcomkBr7_PLbl_pRuMS3oXWU0M)

I am the ONLY political candidate with the stones to say these things. And that’s exactly why the soft RINO Establishment wants me gone.

body:
I’m all-in.

_(This email is a little longer than usual. If you’re short on time,[I hope you’ll split a donation between John Hickenlooper and me ahead of our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133851164/629305584/-1149673710?amounts=10,15,25,50,75,100,250&refcode=email_062326_warner&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNhMmQ1Yy0xNjZmLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UWR-twWqeANlI9u579NnXOA3SJdUWFp3Qsi1Qm2s8zw=). Every donation we receive before June ends puts us in a stronger position in the final months ahead of the midterms.)_ Folks, When I decided to run for reelection to the U.S. Senate, it was not a decision I made lightly. Asking Virginians to rehire me is a humbling task – and it’s one that I take very seriously. **But, after seeing the crazed, dangerous, and callous actions of the second Trump term, I'm all-in on this race.** In my time in public service, I’ve never seen anything like I have the last seventeen months. Trump’s policies are skyrocketing prices for working families. They’re stripping health care away from millions of Americans to pay for tax breaks for those at the very top. And their reckless foreign policy is making our country less safe. And all the while, I’ve been disappointed to see too many of my Republican colleagues refuse to take any meaningful action to hold Trump and his reckless administration accountable. **But frankly, I also know that this race has to be about more than simply what we’re _against_ – we need a vision of what we’re fighting _for._** I’m running for reelection to not only continue standing up to the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption, but to also deliver real results for Virginia’s families: → We need universal health care in this country. I’ve long supported Obamacare, but simply patching up the old system isn’t cutting it anymore for the families who can’t pay their hospital bills or for life-saving prescriptions. → Virginians are facing a housing affordability crisis. We need to build more housing, rehabilitate existing structures, speed up permitting, and make it easier for first-time home buyers to obtain a mortgage. → We need to prepare our workforce for the economies of the future – making sure working Americans benefit from the good that could come from Artificial Intelligence and make sure Big Tech pays their fair share for the demand they’re placing on our energy grid. → We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world. That means working with our allies – not against them – and restoring our leadership on the world stage. **Folks, there’s no doubt these are big challenges – but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight, and I know you aren’t either.** So here’s the deal: my campaign is coming up on our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline and we’ve set an ambitious goal of raising $250,000 from grassroots donors like you before the month ends. These fundraising benchmarks are critical for my fight to protect this Senate seat and elect Democrats in all corners of the Commonwealth to flip the balance of power in Washington. Your support determines what kinds of resources we have in the months ahead, and they guide the strategic decisions we’re making _now_ to put us in a strong position come the fall. [So I’m asking: can I count on your support today to help us reach our fundraising goal? Your donation will be split between my campaign and John Hickenlooper.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133851165/629305612/-1149673710?amounts=10,15,25,50,75,100,250&refcode=email_062326_warner&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNhMmQ1Yy0xNjZmLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UWR-twWqeANlI9u579NnXOA3SJdUWFp3Qsi1Qm2s8zw=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Mark Warner and John Hickenlooper will go through immediately:_ | | | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/133851166/629305613/-1149673710?express_lane=true&amounts=5,15,25,50,75,100,250&amount=5&refcode=email_062326_warner&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83MjY1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzNhMmQ1Yy0xNjZmLWYxMTEtYWM5Yy0wMDBkM2E1NGJlZDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UWR-twWqeANlI9u579NnXOA3SJdUWFp3Qsi1Qm2s8zw=)

Every donation we receive before June ends puts us in a stronger position in the final months ahead of the midterms.) Folks, When I decided to run for reelection to the U.S. Senate, it was not a decision I made lightly. Asking Virginians to rehire me is a humbling task – and it’s one that I take very seriously. But, after seeing the crazed, dangerous, and callous actions of the second Trump term, I'm all-in on this race. In my time in public service, I’ve never seen anything like I have the last seventeen months. Trump’s policies are skyrocketing prices for working families. They’re stripping health care away from millions of Americans to pay for tax breaks for those at the very top. And their reckless foreign policy is making our country less safe. And all the while, I’ve been disappointed to see too many of my Republican colleagues refuse to take any meaningful action to hold Trump and his reckless administration accountable. But frankly, I also know that this race has to be about more than simply what we’re against – we need a vision of what we’re fighting for. I’m running for reelection to not only continue standing up to the Trump administration’s chaos and corruption, but to also deliver real results for Virginia’s families: → We need universal health care in this country. I’ve long supported Obamacare, but simply patching up the old system isn’t cutting it anymore for the families who can’t pay their hospital bills or for life-saving prescriptions. → Virginians are facing a housing affordability crisis. We need to build more housing, rehabilitate existing structures, speed up permitting, and make it easier for first-time home buyers to obtain a mortgage. → We need to prepare our workforce for the economies of the future – making sure working Americans benefit from the good that could come from Artificial Intelligence and make sure Big Tech pays their fair share for the demand they’re placing on our energy grid. → We’ve got to stand up for America’s critical role in the world. That means working with our allies – not against them – and restoring our leadership on the world stage. Folks, there’s no doubt these are big challenges – but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight, and I know you aren’t either. Peter,
We have a critical semi-annual fundraising deadline coming up on June 30th.
We’ll explain exactly why this deadline is a major milestone for our campaign, but first — [**will you make a $5 donation to our campaign today to help us meet our goal and launch into the next phase of this campaign on a strong footing?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260623_1_abbott.qBHfIz&refcode=em20260623-1400&amount=5&t=1&akid=1400%2E299639%2ELlHcZZ)
Here is why June 30th is an important date for this campaign.
This is the very first public financial deadline since Gina officially became the Democratic nominee for Governor of Texas, and _everyone_ will be looking at our final numbers to judge whether our grassroots campaign has what it takes to win this November.
On July 15th, these reports will become public record. Abbott and his team will see exactly what we have to work with — _**but we’ll also get our first real glimpse at his war chest since the beginning of the year.**_
We already know Abbott has an over $100 million war chest sitting in his account. But we also know how he’s filling his coffers: with pay-to-play cash from corporate special interests and wealthy donors whom he rewards with lucrative state contracts.
We don’t need to match Greg Abbott dollar-for-dollar to beat him. But we do need enough to build a competitive campaign, run ads, keep our organizers on the ground, and pay our bills.
**To make sure we have the resources to go toe-to-toe with his special interest machine, we have set a goal to raise $1 million online by the June 30th deadline.**
**[If you’re ready to show Greg Abbott's team that Texas families are ready for a governor who actually fights for them, will you pitch in $5 to help us reach our goal?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260623_1_abbott.qBHfIz&refcode=em20260623-1400&amount=5&t=2&akid=1400%2E299639%2ELlHcZZ)**

Team Gina

---
|
# Important Campaign Updates
A message from Team Nila on upcoming events, endorsements, voter resources, and how we keep this campaign moving forward. |
---|---
Dear Friend, Are you ready to see real change in Virginia’s 2nd District? Dr. Nila Devanath is running for Congress because working families in Hampton Roads deserve leadership rooted in service, compassion, and real-life experience. As a physician, attorney, mother, and community advocate, Dr. Nila has seen firsthand what families are up against every day: rising healthcare costs, expensive prescription drugs, underfunded schools, pressure on working parents, veterans still fighting for the care they earned, and a political system that too often works better for corporations and special interests than it does for everyday people. That is why this campaign is different. We are powered by the people, and we are building a grassroots coalition that stands for working families, affordable healthcare, reproductive freedom, fully funded public schools, paid family leave, support for veterans, workers’ rights, and a government that finally puts people over politics.
|
## What We’re Announcing
Team Nila has several important updates to share: a community endorsement push, a candidate forum, an after-party gathering, a Desi Community Fundraiser, voter resources, and a final-stretch fundraising push to power the campaign forward.
---
| |
## Add Your Name. Endorse Dr. Nila.
We are incredibly grateful for the wave of support we have already received from local leaders, faith communities, community advocates, and organizations across VA-02. But the most important endorsement we can earn is yours. Whether you are a community advocate, local business owner, teacher, healthcare worker, member of the labor community, faith leader, veteran, student, parent, or simply a fired-up neighbor ready for change, we want you on this team. We are building a massive coalition across Virginia’s 2nd District, and we want working people and labor voices front and center. We would love to connect, hear your concerns, and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with you in this fight. [ Endorse Dr. Nila Today ](https://niladevanath.com/Endorsements/#endorse-form)

Join us this week as we continue building momentum across Virginia’s 2nd District.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _
